findings.text: which realises 258 live vertices — at head the same two-arc fixture presents 260 live vertices to _pack_traced_vertices (the pack call receives (1,1024) with 260 valid) and the raised-capacity control admits 260 vertices with area 0.7499999999999982, so the committed count cannot be reproduced from the tree it describes; the refusal claim is unaffected (260 > 136 either way) but the stated number is wrong and a reader re-running the fixture will measure 260.

exact_support_capacity 3840 — the retirement is code-only: no committed artifact carries the derived bound, the newest receipts holding the field still declare the swept product (3840 at 110 cells here, 3072 at 300, 2816 at 1000), and the node's own census receipts (census-hlo-base.json and census-hlo-current.json in the reports fence) declare 3072 on both arms because they measured trees that predate the change, so a certificate run at head is what would state 158 (110 cells) in a receipt.

justifications.durability: The two halves of the refusal each have a committed assertion that fails if they drop (support.refused_cells() == 1 and pytest.raises(TracedCapacityRefusalError) in tests/test_equilibrium_separatrix_clip.py over a two-arc fixture driven through the real traced_clip path rather than a stub), a third assertion pins the derivation itself (traced_polygon_vertex_capacity(30) == 128 + 30), and the zeroed-geometry assertions are kept beside the new ones so the silent case cannot return unnoticed; the reservation is that assert_no_refusal() has no production caller — a repository-wide grep finds only the module and its test — so the fail-closed path is available to a solve rather than armed inside one, and the census script that produced the four-row evidence remains a reports-fence driver rather than a committed test.
justifications.evidence: I reproduced rather than read the load-bearing claims: the committed module gate passes in my own fresh all_debug job (tests/test_equilibrium_separatrix_clip.py, 25 passed in 63.78 s, log under my run's evidence/module-gate.log), the refusal was made to happen rather than inferred (a spy on _pack_traced_vertices shows the refused cell presenting 260 live vertices to a (1,1024) pack call, refused_cells() == 1, the raise fires, and the raised-capacity control admits 260 vertices at area 0.75 so the guard's failure direction is its own), the census receipts' four headline counts and both totals recompute exactly from the raw per-arm census JSONL in the reports fence (1136 -> 212 for (342, 3072, 2), 618 -> 348 for (342, 3072), 636 and 330 unchanged, zero records carrying 342 twice, 236,771 and 239,993 records), and the "to the byte" cross-receipt identity holds against the committed docs/figures/exact-clip-capacity/memory-base.json and memory-current.json (3394009232 and 3011689360 at the 300-cell row); the one reproduced number that disagrees with the record is the two-arc fixture's "258 live vertices" (finding 1).
justifications.fit: All five commits carry conventional subjects with bodies and no attribution trailer (verified line-anchored over each commit message), the added names state the mechanism rather than a plan (TracedCapacityRefusalError, refused_cells, assert_no_refusal, vertex_capacity, refused_cell_count) with no plan, sprint or ticket identifier in any name, comment or message, the receipts are written in the record's voice with the single-null consequence framed as a coordinator question rather than settled, and the census rows are named for their analytic case; the one thing a style reader could weigh is that the realised-layout census is a hand-written driver under docs/figures rather than a benchmarks module, which the moment-quadrature figure directory's existing register does not obviously bind.
justifications.goal_fidelity: Both halves of the node's declared task are delivered and observable at head: nova/equilibrium/separatrix_clip.py carries vertex_capacity and refused_cell_count on TracedClippedSupports, sets included = included & ~overflow so a cell above the bound is reported rather than silently zeroed, and exposes the fail-closed assert_no_refusal, which I made fire (TracedCapacityRefusalError naming "1 clipped cell(s) exceeded the derived traced-polygon vertex capacity 136"), while benchmarks/solovev_certificate.py:3654 replaces chord_capacity * chain_samples with separatrix_clip.traced_polygon_vertex_capacity(chord_capacity) — traced_polygon_vertex_capacity(30) answers 158, the 110-cell value the change intends — and the four-row census covers weak, moderate, strong and single-null at 110 cells; the single-null row's one refused cell is stated as a follow-on with its two consequences named rather than hidden, which is exactly what the dispatch asked be reported, and the reservation is that the retired declaration survives in every committed artifact that carries the field (finding 2).
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff cdc915ba..5d4eca29 names exactly 11 paths — nova/equilibrium/separatrix_clip.py, tests/test_equilibrium_separatrix_clip.py, benchmarks/solovev_certificate.py, and the seven files under docs/figures/exact-clip-moment-quadrature/capacity/ (the four census rows, censused-rows.json, the census driver and its receipts.md) together with the companion docs/figures/exact-clip-capacity/receipts.md — with no path outside the node's declared write paths except that companion, whose edit the coordinator sanctioned in advance in resume-1-advice.txt with the requirement that the manifest name it as a companion path, which the target manifest does; no unrelated file is touched and the identity and memory receipts the census compares against are left as committed.
